purpose: Required evidence input for the next weekly Claude Cowork story draft. It informs research and hook choices; it does not select or publish a story by itself.

methodology.latest_views: Directional mature-topic signal from each record's newest measurement; video ages differ, so do not compare it as a fixed-time forecast.
methodology.frozen_views: First post-upload reading, included only when captured 3-12 hours after upload; use this for comparable early performance.
methodology.hook_retention: Lowest audience-retention value in first 25% of the video. Use it to study hook structure, never to copy a prior subject.
methodology.no_signal: Records at or below the channel's distribution-throttle threshold are excluded from rankings rather than called bad topics.

editorial_rules: Read this brief before researching or drafting any story.
Never repeat a subject in avoid_subjects. The packet validator is the final duplicate gate.

Use strong and weak hook examples for structure only when the brief says hook evidence is sufficient. They come from the top early-performance cohort above the throttle floor, not high-retention low-distribution clips.
Use frozen_views for early-performance comparisons and latest_views only as directional mature evidence.
Treat low-signal examples as questions to avoid or test, not proof that an entire topic category cannot work.
If evidence_status is stale or none, do not call a pattern current; research broadly and wait for fresh measurements before making a performance claim.

strong_mature_examples.subject: Beast of Gevaudan
strong_mature_examples.title: France Sent An Army After One Animal In 1765
strong_mature_examples.opening_line: One animal killed over sixty people in three years. It hunted a single corner of France and would not stop.

strong_mature_examples.opening_line: Two crews dug through a mountain and met in the middle. Samos, Greece, in the mid-500s BC. Through solid rock, by hand.

strong_mature_examples.subject: Shigir Idol
strong_mature_examples.title: Russian Peat Held A Carved Face For 12,000 Years
strong_mature_examples.opening_line: A carved wooden face survived 12,000 years in a bog. Workers hauled it out of Russian peat in 1890, in ten pieces.

strong_mature_examples.subject: SS Waratah
strong_mature_examples.title: This Liner Vanished With 211 People And No Wreckage
strong_mature_examples.opening_line: A whole liner vanished off South Africa with 211 aboard. July 1909. The Waratah, barely a year old, on only her second voyage.

strong_mature_examples.subject: Overtoun Bridge
strong_mature_examples.title: Dogs Keep Leaping From This Scottish Bridge. Here's Why.
strong_mature_examples.opening_line: Around 300 dogs have jumped from the same Scottish bridge. Overtoun, near Dumbarton. Completed in 1895. A fifty-foot drop to the rocks below.

hook_watch_examples.subject: Skara Brae
hook_watch_examples.title: A Storm In 1850 Uncovered A 5,000-Year-Old Village
hook_watch_examples.opening_line: A storm tore open a hillside and exposed stone houses. Winter, 1850. The Bay of Skaill, on Orkney, off the north coast of Scotland.

hook_watch_examples.subject: Bouvet Island
hook_watch_examples.title: An Empty Lifeboat Turned Up On Earth's Loneliest Island
hook_watch_examples.opening_line: An abandoned lifeboat appeared on the world's most remote island. Bouvet. Rock and ice, 1,700 kilometres from Antarctica, never inhabited.

hook_watch_examples.subject: Louis Le Prince
hook_watch_examples.title: He Filmed The First Movie, Then Vanished From A Train
hook_watch_examples.opening_line: He shot the first moving picture, then vanished off a train. Louis Le Prince. October 1888, Leeds — seconds of his family walking in a garden.

hook_watch_examples.subject: Mike the Headless Chicken
hook_watch_examples.title: This Chicken Lost Its Head And Lived 18 More Months
hook_watch_examples.opening_line: A chicken lost its head and lived eighteen more months. The 10th of September, 1945. Fruita, Colorado. Farmer Lloyd Olsen swung the axe.

hook_watch_examples.subject: Baiae
hook_watch_examples.title: Rome's Most Scandalous Resort Town Is Now Underwater
hook_watch_examples.opening_line: Rome's most notorious party town is now under the sea. Baiae, on the Bay of Naples. Its mosaic floors sit about five metres down.

early_performance_watchlist.subject: Marree Man
early_performance_watchlist.title: Nobody Knows Who Carved This Giant Into Australia
early_performance_watchlist.opening_line: A man nearly two miles tall appeared in the desert. A charter pilot found him in June 1998, scratched into a plateau in outback South Australia.

early_performance_watchlist.subject: Herculaneum papyri
early_performance_watchlist.title: Burnt Scrolls Nobody Could Open For 270 Years
early_performance_watchlist.opening_line: These scrolls turn to dust if you open them. Vesuvius carbonised an entire Roman library in 79 AD.

early_performance_watchlist.subject: Beale ciphers
early_performance_watchlist.title: Three Pages Of Numbers Promise $60 Million In Gold
early_performance_watchlist.opening_line: One page of numbers describes gold worth sixty million dollars. It was printed in a Virginia pamphlet in 1885, alongside two more pages nobody can read.

early_performance_watchlist.subject: Great Zimbabwe
early_performance_watchlist.title: Rhodesia Censored Archaeologists For Telling The Truth
early_performance_watchlist.opening_line: A government threatened archaeologists for saying who built this. Rhodesia would allow any answer except the correct one.

early_performance_watchlist.subject: Project A119
early_performance_watchlist.title: In 1958 America Studied Detonating A Nuke On The Moon
early_performance_watchlist.opening_line: The Air Force planned to detonate a nuke on the Moon. The study started in May 1958, seven months after Sputnik went up.

topic_category_tiebreaker.what_this_is: Content-type ranking from the niche scan, shown beside how this channel's own videos performed in the same categories.
topic_category_tiebreaker.how_to_use_it: A TIE-BREAKER between two stories that are otherwise equally good, not a reason to pick a weak story in a strong category, and never a multiplier on a predicted view count. Where the niche ranking and our own median disagree, our own median is the more relevant number and neither is decisive.
